settings.weig.unit.secondShort.reason: The SI seconds symbol s is conventionally used for duration units in Vietnamese technical interfaces.
settings.weig.unit.secondShort.evidence: English canonical is the standalone unit s; the symbol is not prose to translate.

common.na.reason: N/A is a conventional, language-neutral marker for a value that is not applicable or not available.
common.na.evidence: English canonical common.na is the terse technical marker N/A; replacing it would narrow the unspecified case.

header.blog.reason: WeiG Share Blog is the proper published title, not a generic Vietnamese menu label.
header.blog.evidence: English canonical header.blog names the linked WeiG Share Blog publication.

connection.environment.qb.reason: The branded qBittorrent name and colon-delimited diagnostic value need no translation.
connection.environment.qb.evidence: English canonical has qBittorrent: {value}; qBittorrent is the exact application identity.

connection.environment.webapi.reason: WebAPI is an exact technical identifier followed by a variable value.
connection.environment.webapi.evidence: English canonical has WebAPI: {value}; keeping the API identifier avoids introducing an unrecognized translated label.

library.range.reason: The numeric start–end / total compact range format is language-independent.
library.range.evidence: English canonical library.range consists only of the placeholders {start}, {end}, {total}, an en dash and a slash.

language.zh-TW.reason: Display the language's own native-script name rather than substitute a Vietnamese translation.
language.zh-TW.evidence: English canonical language.zh-TW is 繁體中文, the original native Chinese language label.

language.zh-HK.reason: Display the Hong Kong Chinese language name in its native traditional character form.
language.zh-HK.evidence: English canonical language.zh-HK is 香港正體字, an autonym not English prose.

settings.weig.density.torrentExample.reason: Torrent is the internationally used BitTorrent content-type label in a compact preview row.
settings.weig.density.torrentExample.evidence: English canonical density.torrentExample contains the standalone technical label Torrent, familiar to Vietnamese users.
